title: Voice conversation: the person talks, the words go to the chat as their own message once they stop (queued while Tracy works), Tracy says what it does and reads the start of its reply through tracy-web's reading door; the chat box takes no typing meanwhile
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (dependencies installed, a Chrome or Playwright Chromium available) run: node --test --test-timeout=120000 packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/e2e/voice-mode.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-mode.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-mode-turn.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-speak-text.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/speech-say.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: 'Chat or Voice: Voice takes the body and the chat box, listens, sends, works out loud, reads the reply, stops for the person; X back to Chat' passes: the words heard are sent as 'Đổi màu nút liên hệ sang xanh lá.'; the reading door is asked 'Okay, on it.', then Tracy's own words between calls, then 'Got it. I will work that in now.' for words spoken while Tracy works, then the reply without markdown.
'talking over Tracy: it is turned down, stops at the person’s first words, hears them out, then answers that' passes (#1406's held words became talking over Tracy in the PR that followed).
'a turn before the press, and history loaded later, are never read out' passes.
'Tracy’s voice coming back is not the person: under the talk-over level nothing opens, and its words are never sent' passes.
'over the account’s characters for today is 429, and the refused reading costs nothing' and 'without a session it is 401; voice off or no key is 404' pass.
evidence: 16/10/2026: voice like ChatGPT's in the app, a dropdown in the chat header, recording and answering icons, the recognised words in the Chat tab; not silent while the agent works; talking while it works handled like chatting on; no typing while voice is on; follows the /ops Voice switch. Screenshots and the stand run: tasks/evidence/voice-conversation-2026-10-16/.
fence: createVoiceMode in packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/src/client/voice-mode.mjs (the ear, talking over Tracy, progress lines and the reply); turnsOf/followFrom in voice-mode-turn.mjs; mountSpeak in apps/tracy-web/src/speech/say.js (switch, characters per account and day, give-back)

tests: Chat or Voice: Voice takes the body and the chat box, listens, sends, works out loud, reads the reply, stops for the person; X back to Chat
talking over Tracy: it is turned down, stops at the person’s first words, hears them out, then answers that
a turn before the press, and history loaded later, are never read out
Tracy’s voice coming back is not the person: under the talk-over level nothing opens, and its words are never sent
talking while Tracy works steers the words into the work, as a person takes in a correction, and says so
over the account’s characters for today is 429, and the refused reading costs nothing
without a session it is 401; voice off or no key is 404
